newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha swaps well up on Nymex, cargoes quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha swaps well up on Nymex, cargoes quiet.

text.p: The emergency afternoon closure of the London IPE dampened down NWE naphtha activity levels on an already deal-dry Friday, although the rapid NYMEX gains helped force naphtha values up by $3-$3.50 on the day to $189-$189.50 by late afternoon.
Traders were heard continuing to bid for scarce large cargoes at or above the $190 CIF NWE level, but no publicly stated bid or offer levels for pipeline or open spec naphtha were seen.

Reports that a 10,000 tonne raffinate cargo had Thursday been sold out of a U.K. refinery at below published lows underlined the perception of reasonable avails for ARA volumes as large cargoes - especially out of the Med - remained scarce.
